entry.description: A script's account-currency conversion had no rate to read. strategy.convert_to_account, strategy.convert_to_symbol and request.currency_rate (function convert_to_account, convert_to_symbol and currency_rate) answer only from the rate the embedding host supplied, in account-currency units per one unit of the symbol's currency: a scalar, or the curve point in effect at the evaluated time. reason is rate_unavailable when the host supplied no rate in effect at time_ms, unsupported_pair for a pair other than the symbol's currency and the account's, and invalid_currency for a missing or invalid currency code. The same currency on both sides needs no rate and never raises this code; no rate is guessed, derived from another pair or taken from a similar code. from and to are the currencies the call converts between, symbol_currency and account_currency the two the host's rate joins, and time_ms the evaluation's time in Unix milliseconds. The currencies of request.currency_rate may be text the script computed, and time_ms comes from the engine's evaluation. request.currency_rate with ignore_invalid_currency returns na instead of stopping and reports this code and these arguments as a run warning.
english: {call}: no account-currency conversion rate for "{from}" to "{to}" at time {time_ms} (symbol currency "{symbol_currency}", account currency "{account_currency}"): a currency is missing or invalid

{call}: no account-currency conversion rate for "{from}" to "{to}" at time {time_ms} (symbol currency "{symbol_currency}", account currency "{account_currency}"): the host supplied no rate in effect at that time

{call}: no account-currency conversion rate for "{from}" to "{to}" at time {time_ms} (symbol currency "{symbol_currency}", account currency "{account_currency}"): the host-supplied rate converts only between the symbol currency and the account currency
